description: Record the founder’s answer to “did it work?” for a play or plan step they ran: worked, some or nothing, and how many weeks since it shipped. Only from the founder’s own words, after it has run two weeks or more; never your guess. whats_next and next_steps list what is due (outcomes_due, ask_outcomes). Answers are pooled across everyone who uses marketinque and shown per play once three different founders have answered, so the next founder learns what works; the note is never shown. A later answer replaces an earlier one.

note.description: What moved, in the founder’s words (kept private).

slug.description: A play slug, or the plan step slug it was run as.

stage.description: The product’s stage when it ran.

traits.description: Product traits that decide which steps apply (b2b, b2c, ai-native, dev-tool, no-code, mcp, has-integrations, eu-traffic, mobile-app); omit for the generic plan. Free tier only; a project's saved traits are used instead.

verdict.description: worked: it moved the number it was for · some: a little, or not enough to keep doing · nothing: no visible effect.

name: record_outcome
title: Did it work?
